verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a back-office SaaS that holds sensitive company and financial data, so an AI-training opt-out or a no-training data policy is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack addresses AI model training, a data-use opt-out, or a related privacy setting. The VC Discovery opt-in and the sharing of applications with partners concern other data flows and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
